caveats: Exclusions applied per the role rules: UCEDA Institute (school, and a 13-campus chain) and Excel Career Training Institute (school) are excluded even though both operate; if for-profit training schools are in scope, Excel is a greenfield web-presence project and the affiliated Excel Home Care Services agency is the more sellable business.

PRAB Early Childhood Centers sits close to the school exclusion line: it is a nonprofit running state-funded preschool classrooms whose enrollment is processed through New Brunswick Public Schools. Included as operating for completeness but ranked low on ease and ability to pay.

Both 'no website' records (Cerminaro & Associates, Barry J. Moskowitz CPA) were confirmed only via Google Maps cards and third-party directories; neither firm has a site to inspect, so practice areas and revenue are unknown.

Mark H. Jaffe's batch address (47 Raritan Ave, Highland Park) and phone (609-731-0771) match an unclaimed Google card, while his website markets Princeton and does not list Highland Park. Treat the town as a secondary/stale listing rather than a confirmed office.
Google review counts were often hidden by Google Maps' limited (logged-out) view; where a third-party mirror was used for a count it is labelled as such.

Strub Law and Calico CPA both state on their own sites that they are not taking new clients (Strub indefinitely, Calico to no sooner than May 2027). They are operating businesses but weak growth prospects right now.
data_gaps: prab.org and www.prab.org returned a plain '503 Service Unavailable' page on every attempt (browser and direct fetch, multiple user agents), so PRAB's site design, forms, titles and schema could not be reviewed. The cause is unknown; a bot/WAF block is possible inference.
Review counts for Garnet, Cerminaro, Moskowitz, Strub and Jaffe were not exposed in Google Maps' logged-out view.
No employee counts, revenue or years-in-business figures were verifiable for any business; size signals are limited to named staff, locations and directory data.
Could not find any Google Business Profile for Excel Career Training Institute at 97 Bayard St.
UCEDA (excluded) and Excel (excluded) were only lightly checked; no form, booking or schema testing was done on their sites.
